result:
If I had the power to change one thing about the world, I’d nurture a deep, universal sense of empathy among people. Imagine if every person truly understood, cared about, and resonated with the struggles and joys of others—if our decisions, policies, and everyday interactions were guided by the ability to walk in someone else’s shoes. 

With such a shift:
• Conflicts could give way to dialogue and understanding.
• Social and economic inequities might shrink as communities collaborate rather than compete.
• Environmental challenges could be tackled collectively, as individuals and leaders alike recognize our shared responsibility for the planet.

By amplifying empathy, many of the root causes of division—fear, mistrust, prejudice—could be softened, creating a world where cooperation is natural and addressing global challenges becomes a collective effort.
